title: Norwegian Lamb Stew
description: A comforting and floral Norwegian lamb stew featuring dry sherry, perfect for a cold evening, with an ayurvedic-rajasic friendly approach to ingredients and cooking methods.
instructions: Heat the oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the lamb and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Remove the lamb from the pot and set aside.
Add the onion, carrots, potatoes, and celery to the pot and cook until the vegetables are tender, about 10 minutes.
Add the thyme and rosemary to the pot and cook for 1 minute.
Add the flour to the pot and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the dry sherry, lamb broth, and browned lamb back to the pot, stirring to combine.
Bring the stew to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, until the lamb is tender, about 1.5 hours.
Season the stew with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
